probability_input: round-trip binary64 parsing of the registered text
probability_mean: compute each arithmetic probability mean on the exact recorded binary64 inputs, round to binary64 once per averaging step
D_order: mean probabilities over runs per sample, then mean of these ensemble probabilities per participant
equality: exactly equal binary64 scores share one threshold; no global rounding or epsilon tie binning
AUROC: weighted concordance with half credit for ties
target_uncertainty: consume saved two-class participant multiplicities shared within direction
